description:
Radiant - Come to Life!

[FOR RAAAAADIANT LOVERS]

"Maybe it was your dream. I don't know about yours, but it was definitely mine too!"

Download:

Spoiler
Download link:
https://drive.google.com/file/d/1-IsvsVZKoCRBLTF7zE9DE0ShsqpsK3Zh/view?usp=sharing

Spoiler view ship:

Spoiler

Description from the game:

Spoiler
"The Vice-Presidents competition to design a capital ship to complement the venerable Paragon bypassed traditional design processes. The Vice President considered numerous prototypes and options, but the most interesting one seemed to be the revival of one of the legendary platforms that caused such widespread disaster: the Radiant battleship. A new generation of Tri-Tachyon engineers, inheriting the controversial legacy of their predecessors, took on the radical task of upgrading the Radiant basic autonomous platform to handle human.

Basically, the engineers had to abandon the unstable "phase" skimmer not only because it was unprofitable in the new design, but also because it was impossible to reproduce a sample of it on a ship of this size. It had to be replaced with a redistribution unit of a reinforced generator. Such a design allows the power generator to be switched to "extreme concentration" mode, which gives unimaginable power for a short period. However, it is enough to crush your enemy.

The resulting ship is a testament to Tri-Tachyon relentless pragmatism. While officially denying any connection to the fleets banned AI programs, the corporation tacitly acknowledges the Radiant combat value. Its combat performance is somewhat inferior to [REDACTED] ships that still use the original autonomous versions of the Radiant, vindicating the controversial decision to revive the platform. And while its presence in the Tri-Tachyon fleet is frowned upon by the Hegemony and the Church of Ludd, that apparently doesnt stop the corporation from using [REDACTED] designs in a new guise.

Nevertheless, he stands before you. Again."

This modification adds a truly legendary battleship "Radiant" to the game in a reimagined style. This is my first mod, so don't scold the raccoon's soul too much. I will be very glad to hear your feedback on the balancing of this ship. So far, the balance is shifted towards the vanilla game, namely the battleship "Paragon". My version of the "Radiant" for Tri-Tachyon was balanced around it, so it is worse than its "automated" version in the narrow sense of the word. A distinctive feature from the "Paragon" is that the "Radiant TT" has less armor and hull strength, but increased mobility and a changed ability to "Increased Energy Focus". This makes it mainly an attacker rather than a defencer. I think you will like it!

At this point in time, I have not yet added its blueprint for spawning on research labs in the depths of space. However, this is still the first version of the mod and the "Radiant" can only be obtained from Tri-Tachyon. But I think this will not be a problem if you have a cooperative relationship with them. The ship is also included in the Tri-Tachyon fleets.

- The mod was tested on a build with 105+ mods. No crashes or problems were noticed. But if you found something - leave a message in the thread. :3
- In Nexelerin, when choosing the "Tri-Tachyon" faction, you can take it as a starting ship if you go to the very end of the fleet selection menu and click the "Custom" button.
- There are plans for the future to add or integrate the mod with other developers, if they agree.

Changelog:

Spoiler
Version 1.0.1a
- Added blueprint package for spawn on Research Station
- Ship speed reduced by 5
- Sprite slightly corrected (You might notice, hehe, but I'm too lazy to upload pictures to Imgur :3)

Version 1.0.0
- Added battleship "Radiant TT" (Tri-Tachyon)
